Tamil Nadu expands Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme for school students

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin launched an expanded Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme on Tuesday. The expansion will benefit approximately 15.3 lakh students in Classes VI to VIII across 15,454 government and government-aided schools in the state.
